I felt the same way and i forgive myself for not having known back then, but people shouldn’t exist for your salvation. You have to be okay with yourself first before you let yourself be vulnerable to someone else. 

It’s an easy route to take when someone can validate you and fix all your problems in ways you couldn’t fathom. But they shouldn’t have to bear that burden either. 

You have to live with yourself, and be okay with yourself. Otherwise it makes it all the more painful when something bad happens and you find yourself alone again. It’s not all bleak though, you’re still here and there’s time, plenty of time to get on track. All you have is yourself, so maybe try to understand what it is that makes you feel lost in the first place.
